rounds.response: Risk: Low — device/IP match customer’s home region, long tenure and clean history, no velocity or anomaly flags, and the amount is within configured tolerance as a one-off discretionary purchase. Place a short soft-monitor (48–72 hours) to observe for immediate follow-on indicators (additional same-merchant high-value purchases, chargebacks/returns, shipping to a new address, or sudden device/IP changes) and escalate to manual review only if those triggers occur. Log the lead analyst rationale in case notes and allow the transaction to post under normal workflow.
